_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::linear_elasticity#4 / fourc::structural_mechanics#7 — which eletype owns 2D structural cells is VERSION-DEPENDENT, and the two spellings share no keywords: 4C <= 2026.2 uses 'WALL QUAD4 ... MAT m KINEM k EAS e THICK t STRESS_STRAIN s GP a b' (the SOLID factory registers 3D cell types only), while 4C >= 2026.3 folds 2D into 'SOLID QUAD4 ... THICKNESS t PLANE_ASSUMPTION p' and 'WALL' becomes an unknown eletype. HISTORY: the original 2026-06-01 fixture asserted the SOLID-era outcome verbatim (expected "Unknown type 'WALL' of finite element" from 4C_comm_parobjectfactory). Re-running it 2026-08-03 against the deployed 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf, /home/alexander/4C/build/4C) FALSIFIED that expectation on this host: SOLID rejects quad4 with "Element 'SOLID' does not seem to know cell type 'quad4'" and the full WALL line reaches fill_complete. In this 4C tree 109 of the 1974 tests/input_files decks use WALL against 3 that use SOLID QUAD4, and those 3 do not run. Rather than delete the claim (still true upstream) or invert it (would then be false upstream), the fixture now probes BOTH spellings and asserts the era-agnostic invariant EXACTLY_ONE_2D_FACTORY=yes, printing a VERDICT line naming the winner on the host it ran on. Verified by execution 2026-08-03: VERDICT: 2D_ELEMENT=WALL.
